result:
The re-test did not run, so I can't tell you which earlier defects are fixed. tester-c couldn't build the temp copy of the repo, and without the copy it ran no attacks. You told it to work only on a copy, so it did not attack the real repo.

- **Allowed:** `echo "$TMPDIR"` printed `/tmp/claude-501`, and a `git ls-files` listing of the repo files ran.
- **Denied:** every command that creates the copy, whether `mkdir` with `cp -R` or `git ls-files … | tar … | tar -xf - -C $TMPDIR/rt2/repo`. The permission system refused with "Permission to use Bash has been denied."
- **Blocked by the guard hook:** a `tar` version with excludes, because its command text mentions `private/`, `.env` or `.ssh`.

Everything below comes from tester-c reading `tools/abos/phasereport.py`. These are code-reading expectations, not test results.

| Earlier defect | What the code now does | Status |
|---|---|---|
| `--write` could go anywhere (`../`, absolute paths, symlinks, silent overwrite) | Only files under `reports/` are allowed. It rejects `..`, NUL bytes, symlinks, `private` path parts and directory targets. It refuses to overwrite unless `--force` is given. | NOT_TESTED, looks fixed |
| No ledger integrity check (torn line, tampered status, garbage line) | It runs the chain check first and exits 2 on any problem. | NOT_TESTED, looks fixed |
| Raw tracebacks on bad input | Errors are caught and exit 2. | NOT_TESTED, looks fixed |
| Forged heading injected through a test-result field | Control characters and newlines are flattened, so the forged heading can't start a line. | NOT_TESTED, looks fixed |
| A failed `--write` still printed the report | The write now happens before printing. | NOT_TESTED, looks fixed |
| `--write ""` did nothing, and `--write -` created a file named `-` | Both are now rejected. | NOT_TESTED, looks fixed |
| A missing or empty ledger reported "unknown gate" | It now says the ledger is missing or empty. | NOT_TESTED, looks fixed |
| An unknown gate was echoed unbounded with control characters | The echo is cleaned and capped at 60 characters. | NOT_TESTED, looks fixed |

From reading the code, tester-c also suspects some new problems. None has been demonstrated.
- **Low, markdown injection:** the objective, task id, test id and result fields keep link and HTML syntax, so a link like `[x](http://evil)` would show up as live markdown.
- **Low, race:** with `--force` there is a window between the symlink check and the write, and a parent directory swapped for a symlink could slip through.
- **Low, partial file:** a write that fails midway leaves a truncated file, and the next run refuses to overwrite it without `--force`.
- **Info:** the `private` check is case-sensitive, and private-use or unassigned unicode code points pass through the cleaning.

Two caveats. A forged test-result file would still be accepted, because test results sit outside the ledger chain. tester-c also didn't confirm that `./abos phase-report` actually runs this `phasereport.py` and accepts `--force`.

To get a real result, you can approve a copy command like `git ls-files -co --exclude-standard | tar -cf - -T - | tar -xf - -C $TMPDIR/rt2/repo`, or tell me another way to make the copy. Then I'll re-run the tester. I haven't committed, pushed, installed anything or changed any ledger status.
